**Paris Get‑away: 7‑Day Itinerary (Spring/Summer)** *(Assumes you’re flying into Charles de Gaulle Airport and staying in a centrally located boutique hotel or Airbnb in the 1st–7th arrondissements.)* | Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | |-----|---------|-----------|---------| | **Day 1 – Arrival & Orientation** | • Arrive, clear customs, take a taxi or RER B to your accommodation.
• Check‑in, freshen up. | • Light stroll along the Seine; grab a croissant & café at **Café Marly** (near Louvre).
• Visit the **Louvre Museum** (if time allows, focus on the Denon wing). | • Dinner at **Le Coupe Chou** (classic French bistro).
• Night walk to see the **Eiffel Tower** lights (15‑minute walk from your hotel). | | **Day 2 – Classic Landmarks** | • Breakfast at **Du Pain et des Idées** (famous for pain au chocolat).
• Guided tour of the **Eiffel Tower** (skip‑the‑line tickets). | • Lunch at **58 Tour Eiffel** (restaurant inside the tower).
• Walk to **Champs‑Élysées** → **Arc de Triomphe** (climb to the top). | • Sunset cruise on the **Seine** (Bateaux Mouches).
• Dinner at **Le Jules Verne** (Michelin‑starred, panoramic view). | | **Day 3 – Art & Culture** | • Early visit to **Musée d’Orsay** (Impressionist masterpieces). | • Lunch at **Café Campana** (inside Musée d’Orsay).
• Explore the **Latin Quarter**: **Panthéon**, **Sorbonne**, **Rue Mouffetard** market. | • Attend a performance at the **Opéra Garnier** (or a jazz club like **Le Caveau de la Huchette**). | | **Day 4 – Day Trip to Versailles** | • Take RER C to **Palace of Versailles** (book skip‑the‑line tickets). | • Tour the Hall of Mirrors, Royal Apartments, and Gardens (rent a golf cart for the gardens). | • Return to Paris; dinner at **L’Atelier de Joël Robuchon** (French haute cuisine). | | **Day 5 – Montmartre & Hidden Gems** | • Breakfast at **Le Pain Quotidien** (Montmartre).
• Climb to **Sacré‑Coeur**; enjoy panoramic city views. | • Explore **Place du Tertre** (artists’ square), **Moulin Rouge** backdrop.
• Visit **Espace Dalí** or **Musée de Montmartre**. | • Dinner at **La Maison Rose** (iconic Montmartre bistro).
• Optional cabaret show at **Le Lido**. | | **Day 6 – Shopping & Relaxation** | • Brunch at **Café de Flore** (Saint‑Germain‑des‑Pres). | • Shopping spree: **Galeries Lafayette**, **Printemps**, **Le Bon Marché**.
• Relax in **Jardin du Palais‑Royal** or **Luxembourg Gardens**. | • Casual dinner at **Le Petit Cler** (market street).
• Night stroll along the **Pont Alexandre III**. | | **Day 7 – Departure / Last‑Minute Highlights** | • Pack, check‑out, store luggage at the hotel. | • Quick visit to **Centre Pompidou** (modern art) or **Musée Rodin** (sculpture garden). | • Head to Charles de Gaulle Airport via RER B or private transfer. | --- ### Practical Tips | Topic | Recommendation | |-------|----------------| | **Transportation** | • Buy a **Paris Visite** pass (zones 1‑3) for unlimited metro/bus/RER rides.
• For day trips, consider a **Rail Pass** or book tickets in advance online. | | **Dining** | • Reserve tables 2–3 days ahead for Michelin‑starred restaurants.
• Try local specialties: escargot, coq au vin, macarons, cheese platters. | | **Tickets** | • Book major attractions (Eiffel Tower, Louvre, Musée d’Orsay, Versailles) online to avoid queues.
• Use the official apps for each museum for audio guides. | | **Weather** | • Pack layers; spring can be cool, summer hot. Bring an umbrella (Paris can rain unexpectedly). | | **Language** | • Basic French phrases help; most places accept English, but a few locals appreciate a greeting in French. | | **Safety** | • Keep valuables in a money belt; watch out for pickpockets near major tourist spots. | --- ### Suggested Budget (per person) | Category | Approx. Cost | |----------|--------------| | Flights (round‑trip) | $600–$1,200 (depending on origin) | | Accommodation (7 nights) | $1,200–$2,500 (mid‑range hotel) | | Meals | $30–$70 per day ($210–$490 total) | | Attractions & Tours | $250–$400 | | Transportation (within Paris) | $50–$80 | | Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | $100–$200 | | **Total** | **$2,300–$4,000** | Feel free to tweak the itinerary based on your interests—whether you prefer museums, food, nightlife, or a relaxed pace. Bon voyage!
message.reasoning: The user says "Plan me a trip to Paris". They want a plan. We can provide a travel itinerary. No tool needed. Just respond with a plan.
